Difference between two Temporal values

Source: R/arithmetic.R, R/instant.R, R/zoned-date-time.R
temporal_until.Rd

Temporal's until() and since(): the duration from x to other (until), or from other to x (since), balanced up to largest_unit and rounded to smallest_unit (design 6.6). Defaults follow the type: days for dates and date-times, hours for times, zoned values and instants, years for year-months. Two zoned_date_time() values in different zones can only be differenced in time units.

Usage

temporal_until(
  x,
  other,
  ...,
  largest_unit = NULL,
  smallest_unit = NULL,
  rounding_increment = 1,
  rounding_mode = "trunc"
)

temporal_since(
  x,
  other,
  ...,
  largest_unit = NULL,
  smallest_unit = NULL,
  rounding_increment = 1,
  rounding_mode = "trunc"
)

Arguments

x

A zutempo value.

other

A value of the same class, or a string its constructor reads.

...

Must be empty.

largest_unit, smallest_unit

Temporal units, singular or plural; largest_unit may be "auto".

rounding_increment

A positive integer that divides the next larger unit evenly for time units.

rounding_mode

One of the nine rounding modes; "trunc" by default.

Value

A duration().

Examples

temporal_until(plain_date("2026-01-31"), "2026-03-01")
#> <zutempo_duration[1]>
#> [1] P29D
temporal_until(plain_date("2026-01-31"), "2026-03-01", largest_unit = "month")
#> <zutempo_duration[1]>
#> [1] P1M1D
temporal_since(plain_time("13:30"), "12:00")
#> <zutempo_duration[1]>
#> [1] PT1H30M
